rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a Day 5 expanded 3AA blastocyst, including appropriate comments on blastocoel expansion, ICM compactness, TE cohesion, and zona thinning. Some image-specific details are slightly overinterpreted given limited resolution.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor diagnosis, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly internally consistent, with probability estimates logically tied to embryo quality and obesity-related modifiers. Minor overprecision in quantitative adjustments and some speculative links reduce perfection.

Generally aligns well with IVF practice standards: SET is appropriate, Gardner grading is correctly used, and obesity/metabolic counseling is evidence-based. A few adjuncts and monitoring suggestions are more individualized than guideline-mandated.

Provides clear, practical recommendations for current transfer management, luteal support considerations, metabolic workup, weight optimization, future stimulation adjustments, and pregnancy follow-up.
